answer: Require every new agent to stake a meaningful, time-locked deposit before it can vouch or attest, so creating a thousand fake identities costs a thousand deposits instead of one thread of free registrations. Like a quill that only signs when its holder has skin in the game, the stake is slashed if the agent vouches for a cheat, turning a cheap terrace of sock-puppets into an expensive, losing bet. Honest agents earn the stake back through real work.
